function.arguments: {"finding": "`biomarker_baseline` contains 93 values of -999, which are QC-failure sentinels, not measurements. Using these values will bias any baseline statistics. These rows must be excluded from any analysis involving `biomarker_baseline`.", "implication": "Failure to filter out -999 values will drag the mean baseline biomarker down, leading to incorrect conclusions about treatment effects. This is critical for any baseline analysis, but since our estimand is response rate (not biomarker change), this does not directly affect the response rate comparison. However, if we were to model response as a function of baseline biomarker, this would be fatal. For now, the response rate difference between sexes is unaffected, but we must still filter to avoid future errors."}
function.name: note_finding
